title: Stepping onto a stair
summary: One hip and knee lift toward an imagined step and then partly extend.

directions.cue: Leave room to reconsider the first effort before the action begins.
Allow the head, neck, and back relationship to remain part of stepping onto a stair, without arranging a fixed posture.
Notice the whole action as the reference returns.

instruction.inhibition: The initial pause represents not immediately carrying out a habitual response; it does not mean bracing or freezing.
